يستأنون (form X)
# يَسْتَأْنُونَ (yastaʔnūna) /jas.taʔ.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
# يُسْتَأْنَوْنَ (yustaʔnawna) /jus.taʔ.naw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
